crossRefs.note: It shall be, when Yahweh your God brings you into the land which he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to…
and houses full of all good things which you didn’t fill, and cisterns dug out which you didn’t dig, vineyards and…
For the land, where you go in to possess isn’t like the land of Egypt that you came out of, where you sowed your seed…
I have come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land to a good and…
“So the children went in and possessed the land, and you subdued before them the inhabitants of the land, the…
They took fortified cities and a rich land, and possessed houses full of all good things, cisterns dug out, vineyards…
You visit the earth, and water it. You greatly enrich it. The river of God is full of water. You provide them grain…
in that day I swore to them, to bring them out of the land of Egypt into a land that I had searched out for them…

translations.web: For Yahweh your God brings you into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of springs, and underground water flowing into valleys and hills;
translations.bsb: For the LORD your God is bringing you into a good land, a land of brooks and fountains and springs that flow through the valleys and hills;
translations.kjv: For the LORD thy God bringeth thee into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of fountains and depths that spring out of valleys and hills;
translations.asv: For Jehovah thy God bringeth thee into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of fountains and springs, flowing forth in valleys and hills;
